06 - Hoeven (2), Noord-Brabant, 16-05-2012

In the early hours of Wednesday May 16th Robbert van de Broeke again forefelt that there was a new cropcircle to be found in the area where he lives. The weatherconditions were though in the night the cropcircle was formed; heavy showers and stormy winds. The crop shows the effect of that. The grass is high, soon to be mowed, and goes down easily. Although I'm used to spotting crop cormations , and with the exact directions given by Roy Boschman, it was difficult to see the formation from the road, eventhough it was only a few feet away.

The formation consists of circles and rings, 10 in number, with a curly figure at the end. The cirlces vary in diameter from 90 cm. till 6,9 metre. The lay is counter clockwise and rough like a strong energy hit the field. In some circles the swirls were off-centered. In some of the circles I found bend- and elongated nodes.

No signs of human interference was found.
